apple.definition: A round fruit with firm flesh and red, green, or yellow skin.

banana.definition: Any of several tropical and subtropical treelike herbs of the genus Musa having a terminal crown of large entire leaves and usually bearing hanging clusters of elongated fruits.

orange.definition: Round yellow to orange fruit of any of several citrus trees.

grape.definition: A cluster of small projectiles fired together from a cannon to produce a hail of shot.

strawberry.definition: A small red fruit with tiny seeds on its surface.

watermelon.definition: A large fruit with a green rind and sweet red or pink flesh.

mango.definition: Large evergreen tropical tree cultivated for its large oval fruit.

pear.definition: Sweet juicy gritty-textured fruit available in many varieties.

pineapple.definition: A tropical American plant bearing a large fleshy edible fruit with a terminal tuft of stiff leaves.

lemon.definition: Yellow oval fruit with juicy acidic flesh.

lime.definition: The green acidic fruit of any of various lime trees.

carrot.definition: A long orange root vegetable that grows underground.

broccoli.definition: Plant with dense clusters of tight green flower buds.

onion.definition: A strong-smelling vegetable with layers used in cooking.

tomato.definition: A soft red fruit used in salads, sauces, and cooking.

cucumber.definition: A melon vine of the genus Cucumis.

lettuce.definition: A leafy green vegetable often used in salads.

potato.definition: A round underground vegetable often boiled, baked, or fried.

mushroom.definition: A living organism with a cap and stem, often found in soil.

spinach.definition: Southwestern Asian plant widely cultivated for its succulent edible dark green leaves.

garlic.definition: Bulbous herb of southern Europe widely naturalized.

corn.definition: A tall cereal plant with yellow grains used for food or animal feed.

chicken.definition: A bird kept on farms for eggs and meat.
chicken.exampleUsage: The chicken was identified during the lesson.

beef.definition: Cattle that are reared for their meat.

pork.definition: Meat from a domestic hog or pig.

fish.definition: An animal caught with a fishing line or net.
fish.exampleUsage: The fish was identified during the lesson.

shrimp.exampleUsage: The shrimp was identified during the lesson.
shrimp.definition: A small sea animal with a curved body, many legs, and a hard shell.

sausage.definition: Highly seasoned minced meat stuffed in casings.

ham.definition: (Old Testament) the second son of Noah.

bacon.definition: English scientist and Franciscan monk who stressed the importance of experimentation.

turkey.definition: A large farm bird with a fan-shaped tail, often eaten at holidays.
turkey.exampleUsage: The turkey was identified during the lesson.

salmon.definition: Flesh of any of various marine or freshwater fish of the family Salmonidae.
salmon.exampleUsage: The salmon was identified during the lesson.

tuna.definition: Tropical American prickly pear of Jamaica.

lamb.definition: A young sheep with soft wool and a short tail.

yogurt.definition: A custard-like food made from curdled milk.

cream.definition: The best people or things in a group.

roll.definition: A small round or oval piece of bread served with a meal.

bagel.definition: (Yiddish) glazed yeast-raised doughnut-shaped roll with hard crust.

croissant.definition: A light, flaky pastry shaped like a crescent.

cake.definition: A sweet baked food that may be decorated or filled.

pie.definition: A baked dish with a pastry crust and sweet or savoury filling.

cookie.definition: A small sweet baked food, often flat and crisp.

produce-section.definition: A grocery store area where customers select fresh fruits and vegetables is called the produce section.

deli-counter.definition: A staffed counter where prepared foods, sliced meats, cheeses, salads, or similar items are sold.
deli-counter.exampleUsage: The customer waited at the deli counter.

frozen-foods.definition: Food kept frozen so it stays good while stored, moved, or sold.

checkout.definition: The latest time for vacating a hotel room.

aisle.definition: A long narrow passage (as in a cave or woods).

shopping-cart.definition: Describes a cart used to hold items while someone shops in a store.

basket.definition: The quantity contained in a basket.

cash-register.definition: A machine in a store that adds up purchases, keeps sales records, and prints receipts.
cash-register.exampleUsage: The cash register was used during the activity.

scale.definition: A device that measures how heavy a person or object is.
scale.exampleUsage: The scale was used during the activity.

price-tag.definition: A choice has a figurative price tag when it brings a cost or consequence.

receipt.definition: A written or digital record showing that a payment was made.

barcode.definition: Black lines and white spaces form a code a machine reads to identify an item.
barcode.exampleUsage: The barcode was used during the activity.

shopping-bag.definition: A bag made from plastic or thick paper carries things home from a store. It often has handles for easy carrying.

coupon.definition: A negotiable certificate that can be detached and redeemed as needed.

shopping-list.definition: A written list of things someone plans to buy.

credit-card.definition: A card from a bank lets you buy things using borrowed money. It works only until you reach its spending limit. You usually repay the money with extra money called interest.

cash.definition: Money in the form of bills or coins.

change.definition: A different or fresh set of clothes.

wallet.definition: A pocket-size case for holding papers and paper money.

cherry.definition: Wood of any of various cherry trees especially the black cherry.

kiwi.definition: A native or inhabitant of New Zealand.

muffin.definition: A small sweet baked cake, often with fruit or chocolate.

shelf.definition: A support that consists of a horizontal surface for holding objects.

counter.definition: Game equipment (as a piece of wood, plastic, or ivory) used for keeping a count or reserving a space in various card or board games.

cashier.definition: A worker who takes payments and gives change or receipts.

customer.definition: A person who pays for goods or services.

butcher.definition: A person who slaughters or dresses meat for market.

baker.definition: A person who bakes bread or cake.

manager.definition: A person who controls resources and expenditures.

stock-clerk.definition: A store worker who receives, organizes, records, and replenishes merchandise.
stock-clerk.exampleUsage: The stock clerk placed new products on the shelves.

security-guard.definition: A person who protects a building and its people.

delivery-driver.definition: A worker whose job is to transport and deliver goods or orders.
delivery-driver.exampleUsage: The delivery driver unloaded boxes at the market.

shopper.definition: A person who visits stores in search of articles to buy.

child.definition: A young person who has not become an adult.

cart.definition: To transport something in a cart.

bag.definition: A flexible container with a single opening.
